anomalies.observed: On the Power sheet the INA219 (U10) has its pin marked 'SCL' (pin 5) tied to NET0009 and its pin marked 'SDA' (pin 6) tied to NET0040. On the same I2C bus (NET0009/NET0040) the other two devices map SCL->NET0009 and SDA->NET0040: PCA9685 U6 pin 26 (SCL)=NET0009, pin 27 (SDA)=NET0040, and EEPROM U17 pin 1 (SCL)=NET0009, pin 3 (SDA)=NET0040. However, per the INA219AIDCNR datasheet the physical package is pin 5 = SDA and pin 6 = SCL, so the symbol's pin-number-to-function assignment is reversed: the chip's SDA pad (5) is wired onto the bus SCL net (NET0009) and its SCL pad (6) onto the bus SDA net (NET0040), i.e. the INA219's I2C lines are crossed relative to every other device on the bus.
anomalies.expected: The INA219's SDA pin (physical pin 5) should sit on the SDA net and its SCL pin (physical pin 6) on the SCL net, consistent with U6 and U17 on NET0009/NET0040, so that the part can be addressed at 0x40 like the rest of the bus.

evidence.quote: Power sheet, U10 INA219AIDCNR: '5 SCL' -> NET0009, '6 SDA' -> NET0040 (I2C address: 0x40)
FCC Peripherals sheet, U6 PCA9685PW: '26 SCL' -> NET0009, '27 SDA' -> NET0040; U17 24CW1280T-I_OT: '1 SCL' -> NET0009, '3 SDA' -> NET0040
Current/voltage sensor ... TI INA219AIDCNR, I2C addr 0x40 ... PWM/servo driver ... PCA9685PW ... I2C addr 0x40 (both on the FCC I2C segment NET0009/NET0040)

anomalies.impact: With SCL and SDA swapped at the INA219's physical pads, the device cannot be addressed on the bus; battery current/voltage/power sensing (U10) fails, and the crossed pins can also disturb the shared NET0009/NET0040 bus used by the PCA9685 and FCC EEPROM.

parsed.summary: All major components, rails and values match the specification, and the documented quirks (barometer RESET/EOC mix-up, reference-designator renames, MAX-8Q vs MAX-7Q, empty Sensors.sch) are not anomalies. The one deviation I found is that the INA219 (U10) has its SCL/SDA pins crossed relative to the rest of the NET0009/NET0040 I2C bus (its symbol maps pin 5=SCL/pin 6=SDA, whereas the INA219 datasheet has pin 5=SDA/pin 6=SCL), which would break current/voltage sensing.
